theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_rescaledMeasure_prod_univ
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ), (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet A → rescaledMeasure V x t (A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) * V.weight {z | t⁻¹ • (z - x) ∈ A}) ∧ (0 < t → ∀ (y : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), rescaledMeasure V x t (closedBall y ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) * V.weight (closedBall (x + t • y) (t * ρ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
